argv:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="$(uv tool dir --bin):$PATH"
mkdir -p outputs/synthetic_data_generation/profile/court-assets-verify/setup-native-pinned
TIMEFORMAT="elapsed_seconds=%R"
time MAX_JOBS=2 .venv/bin/python -m spin setup-nht --render-only
nht-render --help
cp .spin/cmds.py outputs/synthetic_data_generation/profile/court-assets-verify/setup-native-pinned/setup-cmds.py
git diff -- .spin/cmds.py > outputs/synthetic_data_generation/profile/court-assets-verify/setup-native-pinned/setup.patch
git -C third_party/nht/gsplat rev-parse HEAD
